findings.issue: Task 10 declares `depends_on: [9]` but both are in `wave: 4`. Validator rule: 'Task with depends_on:[X] must have wave > wave of task X' — dependent task must be in a later wave than its dependency. Same-wave dependency means Task 10 cannot start in parallel with Task 9 yet shares the same wave bucket, which contradicts wave semantics (parallel execution within a wave).
findings.fix: Either move Task 10 to wave 5 (and Task 11 to wave 6) to make the dependency chain explicit, OR drop depends_on/redefine waves so that Final Wave tasks (9, 10, 11) become a strict serial wave chain: wave 4 = QA (9), wave 5 = Deploy (10), wave 6 = Post-deploy (11). Mirror this change in tech-spec Implementation Tasks section.

findings.issue: Task 11 declares `depends_on: [10]` but both are in `wave: 4`. Same wave violation as Task 10 — a dependent task must be in a later wave than its dependency.
findings.fix: Move Task 11 to wave 6 (following the fix on Task 10). Final Wave should be expressed as three sequential waves (4, 5, 6) not a single wave 4 with internal dependencies.

findings.issue: Required Skills format does not match template — it says `/skill:security-auditor — методология OWASP Top 10 ревью кода` with no markdown link to SKILL.md. Template expects `/skill:{name} — [SKILL.md](path/to/SKILL.md)`. Tasks 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 all use the linked format correctly; Task 7 is the outlier.
findings.fix: Replace the Required Skills line with: `- `/skill:security-auditor` — [skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md](~/.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md)` to match the project convention used by every other task in the batch.

findings.issue: Verification Steps -> Automated subsection contains prose rather than executable commands. It states 'Эта задача — аудит, не код. Автоматических тестов нет' but still labels the section `### Automated`. The template's Automated subsection is for test commands. For audit tasks the entire Verification Steps section can be repurposed (e.g., 'Verification: report file exists and covers required sections') or the Automated subsection should be omitted.
findings.fix: Either remove the `### Automated` subsection header and place the verification prose at the section root, or rename the subsection (e.g., 'Deliverable checks') to clarify these are not test commands. Same pattern applies to Tasks 7 and 8 which use the same structure.

findings.issue: Verification Steps contains only `### Automated` subsection with prose 'Не применимо — задача аудит, не код'. No executable verification of the audit deliverable. The report-existence check applied to Task 8 would also be valuable here.
findings.fix: Add a deliverable existence check: `test -f work/cross-source-dedup/logs/audits/security-audit.md && echo OK`, mirroring Task 8's pattern. Alternatively rename the subsection to 'Deliverable' to be honest about its role.

findings.issue: Reviewers section content is just `(none — deploy-pipeline task, no review round)` — a single-line parenthetical. Tasks 6/7/8/9/11 all use a fuller phrasing explaining the no-reviewer rationale (verification result IS the review / auditor IS the review). Task 10 is terser than its siblings.
findings.fix: Expand to 1-2 sentences explaining no reviewer rationale (deploy is operator-driven, success criteria verified via VPS schema checks + journalctl, not by a reviewer agent). Match the style of Tasks 6, 7, 8, 11.

findings.issue: Details subsection 'Edge cases' is rich but there is no explicit 'Implementation hints' as a labelled subsection — hints are folded under 'Implementation hints' but split across the section. Other tasks use a clearly delimited `**Implementation hints:**` bold prefix. Style consistency only — Task 10 actually has `**Implementation hints:**` near the end. On closer read this is fine; flagging as info-level only that the Details block could be reordered for parallelism with the other tasks (Files / Dependencies / Edge cases / Implementation hints order).
findings.fix: Optional reorder: move `**Implementation hints:**` block to the bottom of Details (it already is). No action required — flag was a near-miss; leaving as advisory.

findings.issue: Hard gate 'Zero false negatives on critical pair' is a strong AC but the 2-week monitoring window is operator-dependent — task can technically not be completed by an agent alone. This is the nature of post-deploy QA and is acknowledged in the tech-spec; minor flag because the AC framing could mislead about timing (a passing verdict here may take 14+ calendar days, blocking /done).
findings.fix: Add a note in the AC or Post-completion clarifying that 'pass' verdict requires a full 2-week observation window AND that interim pass-with-pending-monitoring is an acceptable intermediate state if operator needs to /done earlier (e.g., monitoring continues but feature is archived).

findings.issue: PK paths use relative form `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md` while Tasks 7, 9, 10, 11 use tilde-prefixed form `~/.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`. Both resolve but the inconsistency across the batch is a style nit.
findings.fix: Pick one style for the feature. Tilde form is more portable (works regardless of feature-folder depth) and is used by Task 7, 9, 10, 11 — recommend converting Tasks 6 and 8 to the tilde form.

findings.issue: Same as Task 6 — uses relative `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/...` form instead of tilde-prefixed form used by Tasks 7, 9, 10, 11.
